name: lib/gui
description: The A2 graphics + window-manager framework as one irreducible unit: Raster/Gfx rendering, image codecs (PNG/JPEG/SVG/BMP), OpenType fonts, and the WM* component/desktop toolkit. Merged because graphics and the window manager are mutually dependent (see cycle note).
residual: Not in the headless SDK at all: this package IS the window system. This package IS the window system, so every member of it stays home and a `graphical` list would be the whole list.

CYCLE FINDING: std/gfx and std/wm cannot be separate tiered packages — even their library cores are mutually dependent (gfx -> wm AND wm -> gfx), an irreducible SCC. Unlike the lower tiers (which form a clean DAG), the A2 graphics + window-manager layer is co-designed. It is therefore modeled as ONE package: cycles WITHIN a package are allowed, cross-package cycles are not.

provides here is the FRAMEWORK library core (~40 of the 137 WM* + 39 gfx modules). The remaining ~90 are GUI applications/tools with zero fan-in (WMBuilder, WMFileManager, WMCharMap, PET, SkinEditor, …) -> packages/apps.
This is the largest package and the boundary of the headless SDK: std/gui is NOT in the headless image; it is an optional install for a full desktop.
Full library-vs-app membership split is a follow-up; the list above is representative, not final.

Entered 2026-08-24 out of the unclaimed half of source/: X11 (the host display binding -- for the window system what OpenAL is for sound), the two JPEG2000 helpers, the SVG matrix, the character codes and the list of skins and backdrops.

Fifty-odd modules entered 2026-08-24 out of the unclaimed half of source/: the component toolkit (grids, menus, popups, tabs, lists, scrollers), the image codecs and font engines that were never named, the skin machinery, and the text tools over WMComponents. This package does not ship, so nothing about the payload changes; what changes is that they now have an owner.

Moved out of std/ 2026-08-27 by the Rust border (docs/STDLIB.md): the standard library holds what packages talk to each other through; this is a leaf that ob get can deliver. Sources still live in source/ -- only the classification moved. `headless` false keeps it out of the SDK payload.
In on 2026-08-27: FP1616, Inputs and WMEvents from std/base.
